name: /advisor
description: Enable, disable, or choose the advisor model Claude consults during a task.
when_to_use: Use this control when enable, disable, or choose the advisor model Claude consults during a task.

examples.explanation: Use Sonnet as the advisor model for this session.

conditions: Available models and Fable access depend on the account.

name: /feedback
description: Report an issue with session context attached.
when_to_use: Use this control when report an issue with session context attached.

examples.explanation: Report a focused issue with the current session context.

name: /desktop
description: Continue the current terminal session in the Claude Code Desktop app.
when_to_use: Use this control when continue the current terminal session in the Claude Code Desktop app.

examples.explanation: Move the active session into Claude Code Desktop.

conditions: Requires a Claude subscription; Windows support is x64 only.

name: /keybindings
description: Open the Claude Code keybinding configuration interface.
when_to_use: Use this control when open the Claude Code keybinding configuration interface.

examples.explanation: Inspect or change interactive keyboard bindings.

name: /mobile
description: Open the documented setup flow for continuing Claude Code from a mobile device.
when_to_use: Use this control when open the documented setup flow for continuing Claude Code from a mobile device.

examples.explanation: Start mobile access setup for the current account.

conditions: Availability depends on plan and environment.

name: /remote-control
description: Make the local session available for Remote Control from claude.ai.
when_to_use: Use this control when make the local session available for Remote Control from claude.ai.

examples.explanation: Continue monitoring or steering this local session from another device.

name: /statusline
description: Configure the information shown in the Claude Code status line.
